question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom for the given statement.**

One who hurries up always gets the best.

options.text: Brevity is the soul of wit.
The early bird catches the worm.
His bark is worse than his bite.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The early bird catches the worm."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"One who hurries up always gets the best"** means that those who act quickly and decisively are more likely to succeed. (जो लोग जल्दी और निर्णायक रूप से कार्य करते हैं उनके सफल होने की अधिक संभावना होती है)
 
• The word **"early"** in this idiom refers to being proactive and taking action before others do.
 
• The phrase** "catches the worm"** represents the idea of achieving success or gaining an advantage.
 
• This idiom emphasizes the importance of being proactive and taking action rather than waiting for opportunities to come to you.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 1 - "Brevity is the soul of wit" **means that it is better to be concise and to the point when communicating, rather than being long-winded. (संवाद करते समय लंबे समय तक बात करने की बजाय संक्षिप्त और सटीक होना बेहतर है)
 
• **Option 2 - "Forewarned is forearmed"** means that if you are aware of a potential problem or danger, you can prepare for it and avoid negative consequences. (यदि आप किसी संभावित समस्या या खतरे से अवगत हैं, तो आप इसके लिए तैयारी कर सकते हैं और नकारात्मक परिणामों से बच सकते हैं)
 
• **Option 4 - "His bark is worse than his bite" **means that someone may seem aggressive or threatening, but they are actually not as dangerous as they appear. (कोई व्यक्ति आक्रामक या धमकी भरा लग सकता है, लेकिन वास्तव में वे उतने खतरनाक नहीं होते जितने दिखाई देते हैं)
